Release 0.3.5 — Infinity Rising LIVE NOW
,
The ascent continues.
Infinity is Rising with a major update to the game interface — a fresh new look and feel awaits.

---


New Features
,
Early Player Needs System
Eating, drinking, taking damage, and dying are now part of the experience.


Below 20% health, you can only walk
,
PVP and fall damage are active
,
Respawn at the nearest hospital after death
,
Be kind, or don’t. Griefing is discouraged, but the Criminal Justice System is coming soon — enjoy the chaos while it lasts
,
Stamina drains when sprinting and restores faster when standing still
,
Satiation drains over roughly 2 hours; low satiation slows stamina regen and eventually drains health
,
Hydration drains over roughly 1 hour; low hydration has similar effects
Note: The Needs System is not fully databased yet, and data can reset between levels
,

Food and Drink
Grab a bite or drink at Burger Barn, Burrito Boss, Copi Cola, and Moonshot

Medical Kits
Available at medical centers and general stores

Early Gathering System
Collect bushes and mushrooms across Solace. Use Navigation to locate the current test areas

Avatar Creator Music
Three new tracks added by community member CornyG

Added FSR Support

---


Notes and Known Issues
,
Needs System UI may occasionally duplicate; fixed by respawning or restarting
,
Does not currently function in Calido Valley Raceway or Pavilion
,
Not all food or drink items replenish the system
,
DLSS and other Nvidia features can significantly improve performance depending on setup; test and tune for best results
,
Lighting and color adjustments have improved visuals and reduced darkness artifacts
,
Occasionally other players may not appear; performing an emote usually fixes it
,
Interiors may look too bright with Hardware Lumen off; this is under active development
,
Some collision and clipping issues remain
,
Jetpack and racing vehicle stats are mid-rebalance
,

---

Infinity is truly rising — explore, test, and experience the next phase of the journey. (edited)

Release 0.3.6 - Home Bound - LIVE NOW
,
---

Features

The Reserve
A small corner of the Solace Hub City is now accessible through the North West Maintenance Tunnel.

This tunnel can be accessed from the back of the medical facility in the Solace G-Train Station. Access to the full Hub City will be available in the next release once it’s ready.

The Reserve contains the Real Estate Office for claiming future apartments and a showing of all rarities and sizes of apartments, fully furnished. It also includes furnished showings of special build kits.

---

Unwanted Guests
The Terra are attempting to open Rifts in Solace’s Hub City. Their survey drones are filling the maintenance tunnels below.

To reach The Reserve, you’ll have to fight your way through. Bring plenty of food and health packs for the journey — the tunnel is a long one. Best of luck.

---

Land Plots
Signs are now included on land plots in Solace to show rarity and the claim status of each property.

---

PVP Arena
If you can find it, near the medical facility in an offshoot of the maintenance tunnels, there’s a PVP Arena situated inside a decommissioned industrial tank.

This area will remain lawless in the future. Have a score to settle? The PVP Club has you covered.
#1 Rule: we don’t talk about PVP Club.

You’ll also find a near-unlimited ammo supply on both sides of the entries for each team — a temporary feature for this release.

---

Combat and Needs System
Various adjustments have been made to rebalance weapons and establish proper effective ranges.
Fixes to the Needs System have also been made to address stamina issues that were weighing down the experience.

---

Networked Systems
Multiple updates have been made on the networking side to improve server performance. This will remain an ongoing process leading up to Alpha release.

---

Notes / Known Issues


Terra Drones are our first live test of PVE. Players might experience network replication, spawning, and AI logic issues.
,
The Ping indicator is visible for testing purposes.

Below 100 = ideal
,
100–300 = potential issues
,
Above 300 = poor experience — select the closest server region.
,
,
The Needs System is a work in progress and may display multiple UI elements. This can be fixed by respawning or restarting. It currently does not function in Calido Valley Raceway / Pavilion.
,
Avoid dropping items on land plots — they may not be retrievable.
,
DLSS and other Nvidia features can significantly improve performance, depending on your hardware and settings. Some combinations may reduce performance, so tuning is recommended.
,
Avatar skin shading has been updated to improve appearance and lighting consistency.
,
Occasionally, other players may not load properly and appear invisible. Performing an Emote typically fixes this.
,
Interiors may appear too bright with Hardware Lumen turned off. It’s recommended to keep it on if your hardware supports it.
,
Various collision and clipping issues exist and are being addressed.
,
Racing vehicles are mid-rebalance.
,
Lighting and shadows can flicker on fog, environments, and clouds at certain times of day, especially early morning or late evening.
,
The water materials system is being reworked. Some surfaces may appear to have bouncing reflections or other inconsistencies.
,

---

Please report bugs and feedback in appropriate channels to help us improve performance and stability for upcoming releases. (edited)
